overview.title: Sidi Bouzid Beach & Resort
overview.p1: A popular beach strip south of El Jadida featuring wide sandy shores, lively cafés, and vibrant summer vibes.
overview.p2: A short taxi ride from downtown; gets much livelier and busier during summer holidays.
overview.p3: An ideal half-day destination away from historical monuments and stone architecture.

moods.title: What to see at Sidi Bouzid
moods.subtitle: A peaceful coastal resort just minutes from the city center.

1.title: Main Focus
1.desc: Wide sandy stretch, seaside cafés, and classic relaxed coastal atmosphere.

2.title: Closer Look
2.desc: Enjoy strolling along the corniche and relaxing at ocean-view terraces.

3.title: Take Your Time
3.desc: Pair this coastal stop with morning heritage exploration and afternoon beach relaxation.

1.title: Seasonality
1.desc: Quiet in spring and autumn, lively and popular during the summer months.

2.title: Wind & Protection
2.desc: Atlantic breezes can be brisk — bring light layers and sun protection.

3.title: Transportation
3.desc: Petit taxis easily connect downtown El Jadida to the Sidi Bouzid resort strip.

food.title: Food nearby
food.p1: Modern cafés and fresh seafood restaurants overlooking the beach.
food.p2: Great options for an oceanfront lunch or a sunset drink.

q1.question: Is the beach public and free?
q1.answer: Yes, Sidi Bouzid beach is public and open to everyone.

q2.question: How do I get there from downtown?
q2.answer: A short 10-15 minute ride by petit taxi from central El Jadida.

q3.question: Best time of year to visit?
q3.answer: May to September for swimming and sunshine, or year-round for peaceful beach walks.

q4.question: What to combine it with?
q4.answer: Pair it with a morning tour of the Portuguese City and an afternoon relaxing at the beach.

q5.question: Is it family friendly?
q5.answer: Yes, it's a top choice for families looking for wide sandy shores and relaxation.
